# TSFMC Rank and File
## Colonel
The Colonel is the Commanding Officer of the [color=#526875]TSFMC[/color] Colossus Sector Oversight Detachment (CSOD). They ensure orders the Captain give are executed within established guidelines and benefit the [color=#526875]TSFMC[/color]. Below is a list of ranks that can be held as a Colonel.
- O-6 Colonel (Col.) - O-5 Lieutenant Colonel (LtCol.)
## Captain
The Captain is the Executive Officer of the CSOD. They are entrusted with the [color=#526875]TSFMC[/color] CSOD Flagship Halcyon to ensure the execution of orders and protection of marines. Below is a list of ranks that can be held as a Captain.
- O-4 Major (Maj.) - O-3 Captain (Capt.) [italic]The following ranks are valid ranks for Captain, however require in round promotion by a Colonel.[/italic] - E-9 Sergeant Major (SgtMaj. or SGM.) - E-8 First Sergeant (1Sgt.)
## Fire Team Leader
Fire Team Leaders are the backbone of Halcyon Marine operations, taking the lead of groups of marines to ensure their safety and completion of the mission assigned by the Captain Below is a list of ranks that can be held as a FTL.
- O-2 First Lieutenant (1LT.) - O-1 Second Lieutenant (2LT.) - E-7 Gunnery Sergeant (GySgt.) - E-6 Staff Sergeant (SSgt.) - E-5 Sergeant (Sgt.) - E-4 Corporal (Cpl.)
## Marine
Marines are the primary fighting force for [color=#526875]TSFMC[/color] operations in the Colossus Sector. They do the tasks assigned by their FTL or receive mentorship from them to better learn how to be a Marine. Below is a list of ranks that can be held as a Marine.
- E-3 Lance Corporal (LCpl.) - E-2 Private First Class (PFC.) - E-1 Private (PVT.)
## Corpsman Corpsman are they caretakers of all Marines in Colossus space, they ensure that all marines are well in health, and produce medicine to ensure wellness in battle. Below is a list of ranks that can be held as a Corpsman.
- E-7 Chief Hospital Corpsman (HMC) - E-6 Hospital Corpsman 1st Class (HM1) - E-5 Hospital Corpsman 2nd Class (HM2) - E-4 Hospital Corpsman 3rd Class (HM3) - E-3 Hospitalman (HN) - E-2 Hospitalman Apprentice (HA)
## Engineer Engineers ensure the stability and safety of the Halcyon, their main task is to fortify and repair the Halcyon or ships fielded by it to ensure top effectiveness. Below is a list of ranks that can be held as a Engineer.
- W-2 Chief Warrant Officer 2 (CWO2.) - W-1 Warrant Officer (WO.) - E-4 Specialist
## Cyborg Cyborgs are the digital assistance around the Halcyon they can complete many tasks and are great for anti-viral control. They can be assigned any rank at the discretion of the Captain.
